hook_segment.text: לא האמנתי שזה סוגר שקיות בשניות...

causes_to_rate.a: Weak opening visual — flat catalog shot, no motion cue
causes_to_rate.c: AliExpress catalog feel — reads as a marketplace thumbnail, not organic TikTok
causes_to_rate.d: Generic hook text — no specific number/problem/surprise
causes_to_rate.e: Hook–product mismatch — text promises something the image doesn't show
causes_to_rate.h: Non-native Hebrew phrasing — grammatically valid but reads as translated/stilted

a.evidence: 0s, 0.5s, 1s and 1.5s frames are the identical static lifestyle photo (white + pink mini bag-sealers on a wood table with a plant, woven placemat, and fork) -- zero motion across a full 1.5 seconds. This is a still product photo with only the hook-text caption animated over it, not real footage.

b.evidence: The two bag-sealer units are clearly visible, well-lit, and centered in frame from 0s onward -- product identity is not in question.

c.evidence: At 2s the video cuts away from the product entirely into a raw, uncropped screenshot of what is clearly a marketplace listing page: visible chrome includes 'אבטחה ופרטיות' (security & privacy), 'החזרות חינם' (free returns), 'מסירה: יוני 25' (delivery date), and a yellow discount/urgency banner reading 'רק עד 8 בעלי אקספרס'. This is not just catalog-style styling -- it is a literal scraped AliExpress screenshot, still showing page layout artifacts, appearing inside the measured hook window.

d.evidence: Hook text 'לא האמנתי שזה סוגר שקיות בשניות...' names a specific product function (seals bags) and a speed claim ('in seconds'), so it is not pure generic curiosity-bait, but it also never states a hard number (e.g. '3 seconds') or a concrete problem -- it's mid-way between specific and generic.

e.evidence: Text emphasizes an action/speed claim ('seals bags in seconds') but the frames shown for the full 1.5s are a completely static, undemonstrated photo -- no sealing action visible -- and then the video cuts to an unrelated AliExpress screenshot instead of ever showing the promised action.

h.evidence: 'לא האמנתי שזה סוגר שקיות בשניות' is idiomatic, colloquial spoken Hebrew, typical of native TikTok UGC phrasing -- not stilted or translated. (Note: the AliExpress screenshot's own banner text 'רק עד 8 בעלי אקספרס' IS grammatically awkward/garbled, but that text is baked into the scraped marketplace graphic, not the authored hook_segment.text field being rated here -- it is separately captured as evidence for cause (c).)
